messages:
alex: Heads-up — search team flagged ~120 KB pages showing 404 after last night’s /shortlink -> /kb redirect.

alex: Not a full outage but search UX is returning a lot of broken links. Can we do a quick sweep? need volunteers for a rotation to fix and PR small batches.

docs-bot: Scan summary: 117 distinct URLs affected, top prefixes: /kb/guides (42), /kb/runtime (31), /kb/onboarding (18). First detected 2025-11-13T02:14:00Z.

jin: Thanks. Do we know which redirect rule changed? I deployed a couple rewrites around 02:00 UTC.

sam: That was me — I replaced the old shortlink rewrite with the canonical-kb redirect in the same PR (commit 8f3a2b7). Sorry, guess I missed a catch-all. Happy to revert or adjust.

maya: Revert could be noisy. Can we target the affected docs and patch links instead? I can take the first batch if someone gives me a grep command for the repo.

alex: Try this to list pages that reference old shortlinks in the content tree:

```bash
rg -n "https?://(short|s)\.ourdomain\.com" docs/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u > /tmp/broken-kb-files.txt
wc -l /tmp/broken-kb-files.txt
```

sam: For in-place replacement (local quickfix), this sed works but test first:

```bash
sed -E -i.bak 's#https?://short.ourdomain.com/([a-z0-9-]+)#https://ourdomain.com/kb/\1#g' $(cat /tmp/broken-kb-files.txt)
```

sam: I can open PRs in batches of ~25 files and tag them `link-fix-urgent` if that helps review flow.

docs-bot: Note: Staging previews for affected pages currently error with 404. CI is fine for other paths.

jin: I can coordinate reviews. Proposal: maya takes files 1-25, sam opens PRs for 26-50, I'll queue reviews and merge if green. Add `link-fix-urgent` label and mention `@eng-docs` for quick eyes.

maya: Sounds good. I'll start on 1-25 and post PR link here when ready. If anyone sees pages that need canonical changes instead of link swaps, flag them and we can patch templates.

alex: Awesome — ping here when first PR is up. If revert becomes necessary we can roll one rule back, but preferring non-disruptive content patches first. :thumbsup:

maya: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — patching first 23 files. leaving .bak files in my branch so we can inspect.

sam: Great, will open 2 PRs next 50 in the morning. Thanks everyone.

jin: I'll watch CI and do the merge cadence. Labeling convention: `docs/urgent/link-fix`.

alex: Thanks all. Small async wins FTW. :rocket:
